title: Identify European Firaga scoped index 2 projections
changes: Authenticate a sampled word and byte as physical index-2 projections of two existing scoped-reader bases.
validation: Protected source plan e340-firaga-scoped-index2-source-plan-b3kir03p verifies the EUR reader fingerprint, existing literal owners, index arithmetic and five unowned sampled bytes.
limitations: The address-only sample does not identify executing PCs or prove a common invocation. Publication, other indices, callers, scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
